title: Derived open base-change is the mate of the pullback square map
statement:
Let $C$ be a commutative ring, $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], and $a:Z'\to Z$ any morphism. Form the Cartesian square $U'=U\times_Z Z'$ with projections $u:U'\to U$, $j':U'\hookrightarrow Z'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Work on small representatives of the small etale sites in the ordinary unbounded constant-$C$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $h^*$ for exact inverse image, descended termwise [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and $j_!,j'_!$ for termwise extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $\eta:\operatorname{id}\to j^*j_!$ and $\eta':\operatorname{id}\to j'^*j'_!$ be the units of the adjunctions obtained by descending the sheaf extension-by-zero adjunctions termwise. For $X\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},C)$ let $c_X=\gamma_{a,j',X}\circ\gamma_{j,u,X}^{-1}:u^*j^*X\xrightarrow{\sim}j'^*a^*X$, where $\gamma_{v,v'}:(vv')^*\xrightarrow{\sim}v'^*v^*$ are the pullback-composition comparisons of [lem-kun-derived-pullback-composition-monoidal], applied to the equal composites $j\circ u=a\circ j'$. Define $B_E:j'_!u^*E\xrightarrow{\sim}a^*j_!E$ to be the sheaf base-change mate of [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map], descended termwise; its invertibility is [sbc-prop-extension-by-zero-and-arbitrary-base-change]. Then for every $E\in D(U_{\mathrm{et}},C)$,
$$j'^*(B_E)\circ\eta'_{u^*E}=c_{j_!E}\circ u^*(\eta_E).$$
Both sides are maps $u^*E\to j'^*a^*j_!E$, and the equality is natural in $E$. The coefficients are sheaves with values in $\operatorname{ModuleCat}(C)$, not modules over a variable structure sheaf. No boundedness, constructibility, finiteness of $C$, or flatness of $a$ is assumed.

        D((j')^*[A]).map ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso A hsq).hom.app K) =
      L((g')^*[A]).map ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction A j).unit.app K) ≫
        (derivedOpenImmersionSquareMap A hsq.toCommSq).app (D((j)_!open[A]).obj K)
